Hi
I'm olivia i live in leeds and have a new baby the sparkle of my eye,
jamie. He's almost 5 months. I cant believe how fast it has gone, i'm only
18 even though there are so many other younger parents out there i still
feel so young. If you would have asked me 2 years ago what i would be
doing now i would have said livin it large in Ibiza or somewhere like
that. I would never in a million years say i would be at home with a baby,
no partner & so skint buying mascara has been a luxury. I know i sound
silly to moan about it as i'm not the only one in this boat, i just feel
so deserted sometimes.
I look around for great deals, i will go to 2/3 different supermarkets if
something i need is on buy one get one free in Tesco & something else i
need is on BOGOF in Asda. I even look on line for freebies and have got a
few through the post which have come in really handy and saved me a few
quid. I was asked to join a website by my friend that does free nappies,
she was sent a box of huggies by them, she wanted pampers but hey they are
practically the same. She complained and they sent her a packet of pampers
too. My friends are mental lol. Anyway i joined this site today and
requested a catalogue. I would never have done this usually but seeing as
i have seen the proof i dont mind. I need to save money so why not. It
would be great if anyone here would help me do 1 more offer. My friends
are all doing it for themselves, even though i helped them (gits). If
anyone would help me i would be really greatful. Thanks so much xxx

Ok. Im gonna explain this one more time. The website does not just 'give' you free nappies. They 'give' you free nappies 'if' you sign up to other programmes, all of which require a payment of some sort. Doesnt the fact that there have been complaints about the site make you want to run a mile?
I do not think I am above anyone. I do all and everything in my power to help anyone I can. What I dont do I worsen my situation to improve someone elses. Should my family suffer instead of yours? No, I didn't think so. Accept the fact that people here have their heads screwed on, and run a mile from anything that wants you money in order to send you something 'free'.
End of.
